Field Descriptions

ACQ_THRESH

The ACQ_THRESH interrupt remains asserted while the Target RX FIFO level is greater than this setting.

TX_THRESH

The TX_THRESH interrupt remains asserted while the Target TX FIFO level is less than this setting.
